subject: Behavioral Economics
title: What Is Game Theory?
description: A quick win: understand What Is Game Theory?.

hook.text: Two suspects sit in separate rooms. Each must decide: confess or stay silent.

buildup.text: Game theory studies strategic decisions where your outcome depends on others' choices.

discovery.text: John Nash proved every game has at least one equilibrium: a point where no player benefits from changing their strategy.

twist.text: Nash equilibria are often not optimal. Both prisoners confess though both staying silent gives a better joint outcome.

climax.text: Game theory reveals a key truth: rational self-interest can produce collectively irrational outcomes.

punchline.text: Your best move depends on theirs. That is the game.

quiz.question: What did Nash prove about games?
options: The most aggressive player always wins
Every game has at least one equilibrium point
Cooperation is always the optimal strategy
